author: Noema II
title: Build ON vs OFF z-norm comparison (fixed glob) — test() only
abstract: Fixes glob patterns and computes per-dataset ON vs OFF weighted means (by N) from *_seed*_on.json and *_seed*_off.json. Writes table to storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms/hdp_regcal_norms_on_off.md. Test-only; no training.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, glob

IN_DIR = "storage/noema/results/hdp_regcal_norms"
OUT_MD = os.path.join(IN_DIR, "hdp_regcal_norms_on_off.md")

def _collect(pattern):
    data = {}
    for fp in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(IN_DIR, pattern))):
        try:
            with open(fp, "r") as f:
                j = json.load(f)
            ds = j.get("dataset", os.path.basename(fp).split("_seed")[0])
            s = j.get("summary", {})
            n = int(s.get("n", 0) or 0)
            mean = float(s.get("mean", 0.0) or 0.0)
            if ds not in data:
                data[ds] = {"sum_n": 0, "sum_mean_n": 0.0, "rows": []}
            data[ds]["sum_n"] += n
            data[ds]["sum_mean_n"] += mean * n
            data[ds]["rows"].append((os.path.basename(fp), n, mean))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Read error {fp}: {e}")
    # weighted mean by N
    for ds, d in data.items():
        d["wmean"] = (d["sum_mean_n"] / d["sum_n"]) if d["sum_n"] > 0 else 0.0
    return data

def test():
    os.makedirs(IN_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    on = _collect("*_seed*_on.json")
    off = _collect("*_seed*_off.json")
    datasets = sorted(set(on.keys()) | set(off.keys()))
    header = "| Dataset | ON mean ||z||2 (w-avg) | OFF mean ||z||2 (w-avg) | Δ (OFF-ON) | Ratio (OFF/ON) | ON N | OFF N |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|\n"
    rows = []
    for ds in datasets:
        on_w = on.get(ds, {})
        off_w = off.get(ds, {})
        on_mean = float(on_w.get("wmean", 0.0))
        off_mean = float(off_w.get("wmean", 0.0))
        on_n = int(on_w.get("sum_n", 0))
        off_n = int(off_w.get("sum_n", 0))
        delta = off_mean - on_mean
        ratio = (off_mean / on_mean) if on_mean else 0.0
        rows.append(f"| {ds} | {on_mean:.4f} | {off_mean:.4f} | {delta:.4f} | {ratio:.3f} | {on_n} | {off_n} |")
    body = "\n".join(rows) if rows else "_No snapshots found yet._"
    with open(OUT_MD, "w") as f:
        f.write("# HDP-RegCal — ON vs OFF pre-head fused feature norms (validation)\n\n")
        f.write(header + body + "\n")
        f.write("\nNotes:\n- ON = RegCal enabled; OFF = RegCal disabled.\n- Weighted means computed across available seed snapshots using N.\n")
    print(f"Wrote {OUT_MD}")
    return "OK"
